chronotype.rationale: Late-chronotype genotype — peak strength, power, and reaction-time performance shifts later in the day. Avoid 06:00 sessions if performance matters; reserve early hours for low-intensity work.

cognitive.summary: BDNF Val/Val — efficient activity-dependent BDNF secretion. Strong cognitive-benefit response to aerobic exercise.
cognitive.training_note: Conventional aerobic training (3-4 ×/week, 40-60 min Zone 2) is highly effective for mood, memory, and neuroplasticity outcomes.

risks.mitigation: Favourable tendon-stiffness profile — running economy advantage.

factors: ACTN3 CT (R/X) — mixed fibre type, balanced
power_endurance.recommendation: Prioritise heavy strength (3-6 reps) and explosive work (jumps, sprints, Olympic lifts). 2-3 short conditioning sessions/week is sufficient. Avoid chronic high-volume aerobic which blunts your strength response.

factors: rs1800795 (IL6 -174) GG — high baseline inflammatory tone
recovery.protocol: Expect prolonged DOMS and slower clearance of training stress. 48-72 h between hard sessions on the same muscle group. Aggressive recovery: sleep ≥8 h, omega-3, tart cherry, contrast showers.

alcohol.guidance: No alcohol-risk variants typed — standard moderation applies (≤1-2 drinks/day for men, ≤1 for women).

caffeine.guidance: Slow metaboliser — caffeine half-life prolonged (8+ h). Cap at 200 mg/day (≈ 1 large coffee) and avoid after lunch. Higher dose links to elevated CV risk in slow metabolisers. L-Theanine 100-200 mg paired with caffeine smooths anxiety response.

Grilled salmon + large mixed-greens salad + olive oil + 1/2 sweet potato
Light snack — cheese + olives; caffeine cutoff 12:00
Lean protein (chicken, turkey, or tofu) + cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, Brussels) + extra olive oil
Optional: small glass of red wine; finish ≥2 h before sleep.

gluten.guidance: No DQ2/DQ8 risk haplotype typed/detected — coeliac disease is essentially ruled out. Gluten avoidance unnecessary for autoimmune reasons.

lactose.guidance: Lactase non-persistence — symptomatic lactose intolerance likely. Choose lactose-free milk, aged cheeses (parmesan, cheddar), fermented dairy (yoghurt, kefir) which are partially pre-digested. Plant milks for liquid dairy.

factors: rs9939609 (FTO) AT — better response to lower-carb diet

APOE ε4 carrier — lower saturated fat, prefer mono/poly

macros.rationale: Lower-carb skew (~30%) — your variants reduce glucose tolerance.

methylation.guidance: Emphasise folate-rich foods: leafy greens (spinach, kale, romaine), liver, lentils, asparagus, broccoli. Avoid synthetic folic-acid fortified products (many cereals, breads) — they compete with active folate. Choose methylfolate-supplemented options if available.

factors: rs699 (AGT M235T) AG — salt-sensitive hypertension allele
salt.guidance: Reduce sodium to ≤2.3 g/day; emphasise potassium-rich foods (leafy greens, beans, potato). DASH-style pattern especially beneficial.

vitamin_d_food.guidance: Prioritise high-D foods: wild salmon, sardines, herring, egg yolks, UV-treated mushrooms, fortified dairy. Combine with daytime sun exposure where possible (10-30 min, depending on skin tone, latitude, season).

supplements.notes: Genetic recommendations are starting points — confirm with labs and a physician. Doses are typical adult ranges; pregnant/breastfeeding/under-18 users should not self-supplement without clinical guidance.

essential.interactions: Co-supplement magnesium (D activation requires Mg); avoid high-dose D without K2 (calcium routing).
essential.name: Vitamin D3 + K2 (MK-7)
essential.reasoning: Multiple low-D genotypes (CYP2R1 + GC/VDBP) plus/or active VDR FokI — expect persistently low serum 25(OH)D unless dosing aggressively.
essential.timing: With fattiest meal of the day

optional.interactions: Long-term high zinc depletes copper — keep dose ≤25 mg/day.
optional.name: Zinc Picolinate
optional.reasoning: SHBG genotype predicts higher SHBG → lower free testosterone. Zinc supports endogenous T production and aromatase modulation.

optional.interactions: Generally well tolerated; mildly hypotensive in large doses.
optional.name: L-Theanine
optional.reasoning: CYP1A2 slow-metaboliser genotype (rs762551 *1F) — caffeine half-life prolonged; L-theanine blunts jitteriness without reducing alertness.

recommended.interactions: Smells of sulfur; can blunt nitroglycerin response.
recommended.name: N-Acetyl Cysteine (NAC)
recommended.reasoning: Reduced glutathione-system capacity (GSTP1 / NRF2 variant). NAC is a direct cysteine donor for glutathione synthesis — supports detox and antioxidant defense.

recommended.form: Meriva / Longvida / BCM-95 or curcumin + 5-10 mg piperine
recommended.interactions: Mild antiplatelet; pause 1 week pre-surgery; can interact with tacrolimus.
recommended.name: Curcumin (with piperine or phytosome)
recommended.reasoning: IL6 promoter variant and/or elevated genetic CRP prediction — chronic low-grade inflammation tendency. Curcumin inhibits NF-κB and lowers CRP.

recommended.form: Triglyceride-form fish oil or algal oil (vegetarian)
recommended.interactions: Mild anticoagulant; check with physician if on warfarin/DOACs.
recommended.name: EPA/DHA (fish or algal oil)
recommended.reasoning: FADS1 reduced-conversion genotype — endogenous ALA→EPA/DHA pathway is impaired. Direct preformed EPA/DHA supplementation needed.

recommended.name: L-Methylfolate (5-MTHF)
recommended.reasoning: Heterozygous MTHFR 677CT — ~30-40% reduction in enzyme activity. Pre-methylated folate ensures consistent methylation cycle flux.

recommended.interactions: Methyl-donors can over-stimulate in COMT slow homozygotes — start low.
recommended.name: Methyl-B-Complex (B6 P5P + Methylcobalamin)
recommended.reasoning: MTHFR A1298C reduces BH4 regeneration, affecting neurotransmitter and methylation pathways. Active B-vitamin forms support the cycle.

recommended.interactions: Vegans and PPI/metformin users need higher doses; recheck serum B12 yearly.
recommended.name: Methylcobalamin B12
recommended.reasoning: Genotype predicts reduced B12 status due to absorption (FUT2) and/or transport (TCN2) variants. Sublingual methyl-form bypasses both.

recommended.interactions: Very safe; transient water-weight gain; hydrate well.
recommended.name: Creatine Monohydrate
recommended.reasoning: ACTN3 R-allele carriers respond particularly well to creatine for power output and muscle volume. Universal cognitive benefits apply across genotypes.
